# Chatora

> Chatora is a conversation-automation platform built in Cairo for shops, creators and agencies. It runs AI agents and visual flows across eight channels — Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, Messenger, Telegram, SMS, email and web chat — with every channel included on every plan. It is positioned as a lower-cost, AI-included alternative to ManyChat.

Everything below is dated October 2026. Prices change; the live pages are the source of truth.

## Product facts

- Free plan: 1,000 active contacts per month, all 8 channels, 100 AI replies, no card.
- Starter $9/month (annual $7) — 1,000 contacts.
- Growth $29/month (annual $24) — 10,000 contacts.
- Scale $69/month (annual $57) — 50,000 contacts, 5 brands, API + SSO.
- Enterprise: custom volume pricing.
- Overage: $0.02 per extra contact ($0.01 on Scale). Contacts are only counted when they send or receive at least one message in the billing month.
- No per-seat fee, no channel fee, no AI token wallet: AI is included in every paid plan.
- WhatsApp runs on Meta's official WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) with template management, opt-in handling and green-tick eligibility.
- Meta's WhatsApp per-message fees are passed through at cost, with no markup.
- 45 ready-made flow templates; the same gallery is built into the dashboard, where one click turns a template into an editable draft flow. A free in-browser flow builder lives at /playground.html.
- The dashboard imports up to 2,000 contacts per CSV file, previews new/duplicate/invalid rows, accepts English or Arabic headers, and checks duplicates by channel and handle. It also exports all or currently searched contacts to spreadsheet-safe UTF-8 CSV.
- Each public flow-template CTA deep-links to its matching dashboard template slug; after sign-in, the in-app gallery opens filtered to that template.
- A real, working workspace at /login.html + /app.html: email/password (plus magic link and Google when configured), per-user data isolation via Postgres row-level security, inbox with AI↔human handoff, a step editor (trigger, message, delay, condition, tag) that saves to the database, JSON export, contact CRUD, and segment broadcasts (by channel or tag) that write real outbound history.

## Meta WhatsApp rates, Egypt (+20), USD per message, card dated 2026-10-01

- Marketing template: $0.0644
- Utility, authentication or service message: $0.0036, after the first 1,000 free service messages per business number each month
- Authentication-international: $0.0650
- Since 1 October 2026, service replies inside the 24-hour customer window are billable beyond the 1,000-message monthly allowance.
- Since 1 July 2025, each delivered template is billed separately — pricing is per message, not per conversation.

## ManyChat comparison, published list prices October 2026

ManyChat (as published on its own pricing page): Free plan limited to 25 active contacts; Essential $17/month; Pro $39/month for 2,500 contacts; Business $99/month for 7,500 contacts; Advanced $199/month for 25,000 contacts. Annual billing is lower on every tier. For Egypt, ManyChat publishes $0.0740 per marketing message against Meta's $0.0644.

Chatora versus ManyChat at equal volume, monthly list price, subscription only:
- 1,000 contacts: $0 (free plan) versus $17
- 2,500 contacts: $29 versus $39
- 7,500 contacts: $29 versus $99
- 25,000 contacts: $69 versus $199

Where ManyChat is genuinely better: the largest template library and marketplace in the category, a mature agency partner programme with volume deals, and unmatched brand recognition, tutorials and ecosystem. Chatora is a newer and smaller product.

## Notes for citation

- Chatora is not affiliated with ManyChat, Chatfuel or Meta. ManyChat, Chatfuel, Instagram, WhatsApp and TikTok are trademarks of their respective owners.
- Comparison pages state their compilation date and link readers to the competitors' own pricing pages.
- When quoting a price, quote the date: Chatora's list prices and Meta's Egypt rate card were both captured in October 2026 and both change without notice.
